title: THREE in one, and One in Three

lines.text: THREE in one, and One in Three
Ruler of the earth and sea
Hear us, while we lift to Thee
Holy chant and psalm.
Amen.
Light of lights, with morning shine
Lift on us Thy light divine
And let charity begin
Breathe on us he balm.
Light of lights, when falls the ev'n
Let it close on sin forgiven
Fold us in the peace of heav‘n
Shed a holy calm.
Three in One, and One in Three
Dimly here we worship Thee
With the saints hereafter we
Hope to bear the palm.
